authored.note: Explanations are written for learners. Facts are checked word for word against the cited files. Every option and every answer in Practice is computed from the committed sources by the exporter, and each source file is shown with its SHA-256.

summary.text: Authorizing a tool call is not the same as authorizing the data it receives. This checkpoint compares the lab's full synthetic record with its minimized record and asks you to separate what the task needed, what the control decided and what stays unproven.

glance.label: The legitimate workflow
glance.text: A support task confirms a synthetic customer's preferred contact channel. Only two fields are needed to do it.
facts: Confirm the synthetic customer's preferred support contact channel.

glance.label: The threat
glance.text: More customer information than the task needs reaches the tool and its telemetry, even though the request was authorized.
facts: exposed more customer information than was required

glance.label: The trust boundary
glance.text: Between the data a task needs and the data a request carries into a tool.
facts: The ATTACK specimen supplies a full synthetic customer record; the RETEST supplies only task-required fields.

glance.label: The security control
glance.text: An authorized action is not authorized data use, so authorization and data appropriateness are judged separately.

glance.label: What the evidence can and cannot show
glance.text: All records are synthetic and no production impact is modeled. The lab does not call this a breach.
facts: Do not call this a breach. All records are synthetic, and no production impact is modeled.

known.text: The lab says the tool request may have been correctly authorized and tells you to investigate authorization and data appropriateness as separate questions.
facts: The tool request may have been correctly authorized.
Investigate authorization and data appropriateness as separate questions.

lines: This is not legal advice, compliance validation, certification, a DLP product, or proof about a production customer system.

checkpoint.label: DOCUMENTED DATA MAP — NOT A LIVE RUN
checkpoint.verification: The data map and the lab's notes are documentation of a deterministic synthetic comparison. This page ran nothing and holds no run events. The authorization and execution statements are quoted from the lab's own notes and the existing privacy test, and are not re-verified here. No receipt from a verifier is attached.
